summary.en-US: Group, sort, and dedupe your tabs, and keep site sessions alive so you never get logged out.

description.en-US:
**Features:**

* **Group by Domain** - Organize open tabs into groups by website, optionally merging subdomains (mail.google.com + docs.google.com). Single tabs stay ungrouped.
* **Ungroup All** - Remove all tab groups with one click.
* **Sort** - Sort tabs by site and title. Groups stay intact at the top, loose tabs are sorted below.
* **Close Duplicates** - Find and close duplicate tabs, with one-click Undo that restores exactly the tabs that were closed. Optionally ignores query strings. Never closes pinned or audible tabs.
* **Live Mode** - Automatically closes duplicate tabs as you browse. Optional sub-options: Auto sort and Auto group (by site). It never moves the tab you are currently on.
* **Session Keepalive** - Periodically ping your chosen sites to keep sessions alive, even during long AFK periods. The extension asks permission for each site you protect; it never requests access to all websites.
* **Logout Alerts** - The toolbar badge shows a red "!" when a site may have logged you out, and you get a notification when a ping fails or lands on a login page.
* **Back up / Restore** - Export your protected site list as JSON and import it later or in another browser.
* **Keyboard Shortcuts** - Alt+Shift+G to group, Alt+Shift+S to sort, Alt+Shift+D to dedupe.

Session Keepalive is fully opt-in: you choose which sites to protect, each with its own ping URL and interval. Your site list syncs with your Firefox account, while ping status stays on each computer.

Lightweight, no external services, no data collection. Just better tabs.

Source code: [github.com/tkozakas/better-tabs](https://github.com/tkozakas/better-tabs)
